verdict.rationale: Shopify Markets is a documented first-party capability to sell to multiple markets from one store and tailor the store by region. Merchants can preview per-market products and pricing, which covers the core of localized international selling. The evidence never explicitly mentions multi-currency conversion, storefront translations, or duties handling, and the tax evidence covers only US sales tax. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency pricing documentation, translation/localization of storefront content, duties and import tax handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell internationally with localized storefronts, multi-currency pricing, translations, and duties handled
